Definition: from G1537 and G2980; to divulge:--tell.
BiblicalUsage: This word means to tell out, to divulge, and it occurs once, when the chief captain warns Paul's nephew. He lets the young man go and charges him to tell no man that he has shown him the plot against Paul's life, and the boy's silence keeps the apostle alive. One secret kept is the difference between life and death.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God protects His servants through small obediences, because a boy's silence and a captain's warning were enough to save Paul.
